description: This file defines the PatientSaveHandler class, which handles the saving process for Patient objects within the OpenMRS framework. The class primarily ensures that patient identifiers are correctly associated with the patient when the patient record is saved.

classes.name: PatientSaveHandler
classes.description: Handles saving events for Patient objects, ensuring patient identifiers are correctly attached.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a Patient object during save, associating any patient identifiers with the patient if not already linked.
